text: My daily routine is simple but well organized. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and a healthy breakfast. After that, I get ready and begin work at nine. I work until five in the afternoon, with a short lunch break around noon. Three times a week, I go to the gym after work because exercise helps me stay healthy and relaxed. In the evening, I cook dinner, watch a film, or read a book before going to bed at eleven. I try to keep this routine every day, since consistency gives me energy and helps me feel balanced.
